title: Topological Foundations of Multi-Field Instabilities in Continua: Part 1: Foundations Part 2:Analytical Formulation for 1-D Spin Chains Part 3: Numerical Upscaling
summary: This three-part series establishes a parameter-free, topological classification of multi-field instability in granular continua, extending Maxwell's rigidity count to dynamic, non-equilibrium processes.
